description:
Maranza is a contemporary Italian urban subculture that originated in the suburbs of Milan. While the term dates back to the 1980s as a synonym for "boor" or "bully," [ 1 ] it underwent a massive viral resurgence in the 2020s on TikTok, evolving into a specific aesthetic and behavioral identity primarily associated with second-generation North African youth living in the urban peripheries. [ 2 ]

The subculture is characterized by a "pack" mentality, territorial pride, and a musical foundation in Trap and Drill. While frequently associated with micro-criminality and social friction, the aesthetic has become a significant influence on mainstream Italian street fashion.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Territorial pride, urban defiance, social provocation, group loyalty
